_doc: [V21-ACL] grasp-verification calibration of the MEASURED finger opening (gripper joint encoder, normalised: 1 = open). Source: expert demonstrations replayed on calibration seeds 5200000-5200002 (demo_clean; disjoint from every training/dev/final seed range) with scratch probe_grip.py; 'empty' = both grippers closed on nothing. Rule fixed before any ACL evaluation: verification is ENABLED only if (min hold reading - empty reading) >= 0.20; threshold = midpoint(empty, min hold). open_min = reading above which a gripper counts as opened.

place_container_plate.why_disabled: margin 0.053 < 0.20 (thin-walled container: holding and empty readings are too close for a reliable test)

click_bell.why_disabled: no object is held (the bell is pressed with a closed gripper; reading equals the empty reference)
